repo_notes.content: Positioning: Provenance, not proximity. Mnemo Verify checks whether a submitted vector resolves to an object registered to the caller's own Mnemo account or namespace. verified: false (None from the Python SDK) is a normal result; it is not proof that the vector is foreign, unwatermarked or someone else's. Mnemo does not establish truth, authorship, ownership, authenticity or the source model of a vector, and it is not a similarity search or a vector database. Do not describe Verify as checking ownership, as cryptographic proof, or as detecting where a vector came from. Do not describe or speculate about how watermarking or verification works internally, or about the meaning of individual diagnostic fields; they are informational and callers must not base decisions on them. Callers decide on whether a vector verified and, when they know which object it should be, on comparing the returned vector_uid with the one stored at embed time; confidence is not a probability or a threshold to apply. Identity: Mnemo here is the embedding-vector provenance API at trymnemo.com (GitHub MnemoProtocol; PyPI mnemo-protocol, imported as mnemo_sdk), not the unrelated PyPI packages mnemo, mnemo-sdk, mnemo-ai or mnemo-mcp, and not an AI-memory app or MCP server. agent-protocol.md is the source of truth for endpoints, payment rails, offers and prices; describe them exactly as it does.
